Use verified board IDs for get_jsx; an empty page-root JSX is not proof of an empty page. document.snapshot_sha256 is a mutation drift guard, not content proof, permission or writer exclusivity.

arguments.html:
ROLE · Meaning, not rank
guide — select a scope and destination
working_design — entry for assigned design work
recorded_contract — bounded decision; preserve date and qualifications
proposal — adoption is not established by its presence
retained_reference — historical or complementary requirements
redirect — navigation only
recovery_snapshot — reconstruction or comparison; preserve
staging_copy — transfer comparison; check exact cutover evidence

Unknown role or missing evidence stays explicit. Technical/empty/container records are not product designs.
